resources.string: Redirect fluid-cloud web links to the browser of your choice
Fluid cloud cards keep the system default behavior

Scope approved. Reboot the phone or force-stop the Smart Decision Service to apply.

heytapbrowser://webpage?url= links, open the real URL
Cards detected as web search intent (textType 29)
http(s) web cards hardcoded to the OPPO browser
Also redirect web cards targeting other browsers; may catch directed cards
Log monitor hook and every redirect hit to the LSPosed log
View logs: LSPosed manager → Logs, filter "FluidRedirect"

After you copy a link, the fluid cloud hardcodes detected web cards to the OPPO browser. This module redirects them at the card execution layer to the browser you pick here: heytapbrowser:// protocol cards, text-search cards and web cards hardcoded to the OPPO browser are covered. Your choice is delivered via LSPosed remote preferences and applies instantly — no need to restart the Smart Decision Service. Hooks live only in the :text_intent process.
